name: Canudos
declaringWar: For the sake of faith and the honor of the poorest and weakest, you will be ordered to leave!
attacked: First of all, understand that you are attacking a poor and defenseless people, right?
denounced: Keep going, nobody wants to see how it ends.
defeated: Ah yes, it's done. You did it. Good luck.
introduction: Blessings to you and your people. I am Antônio Conselheiro, spiritual leader of this suffering people.
tradeRequest: I am certain that tomorrow's blessings will materialize by accepting this agreement.
uniques: City-State territory always counts as friendly territory

name: Juliana
declaringWar: It's getting harder and harder to put up with you. I'll have to destroy you for the good of the Republic!
attacked: This will not be the end. We will resist!
denounced: You're confusing my respect with fear!
defeated: You defeated me, but you will be haunted by the tears of your victims!
introduction: Good morning, I am David Canabarro, General and leader of the Juliana Republic. We seek stability with our neighbors.
tradeRequest: It will certainly be mutually beneficial to both us.
uniques: Free Social Policy <upon entering a Golden Age>

name: Malês
declaringWar: I heard that some of my men are rebelling near your border, is that true?
attacked: If that's the case, we'll go to war; we will not be slaves again!
denounced: I will have to take drastic measures.
defeated: With this fate, I have only one wish: that God forgives you for your choices.
introduction: May God be with you, I am Pacífico Licutan. The Malês wish you peace.
tradeRequest: This needs to be possible. We'll make sure you don't regret it.
uniques: Gain a free [Mosque] [in capital] <after founding a religion>
"Borrows" city names from other civilizations in the game

name: Palmares
declaringWar: I couldn't help but notice your audacity in turning against us. Quilombolas we will destroy the enemy!
attacked: These lands will never be yours. You will achieve nothing with this aggression!
denounced: I'm interested in what you're going to do after that.
defeated: Your resentment echoes in the destroyed ruins of the mocambos. You may have won this war in name, but I won it in spirit!
introduction: Welcome to the Quilombo dos Palmares, where enslaved people and deserters find refuge amidst the chaos. Tell me about yourself.
tradeRequest: I've been wondering if this is possible between our peoples.
uniques: Can build [all] improvements at a [+25]% rate
